scenario: Everything no capability governs is always available ([LDIA.4.2]; LFCA.10.3, the id, is a tombstone). Pinned via compile_ok of a non-gateable feature (logical-fact emit) under restricted_v1 — restricted_v1 disables `call` but logical-emit is not in the gating catalog so it works regardless.
rules_ds:
use restricted_v1

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Sig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    emit Sig logical v: 99
